title: Industrial Project Implementation Specialist
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Customer at TRACTIAN

The Customer team is the driving factor behind lifetime value, retention and expansion at Tractian. We focus on expanding inside existing customers, cross-selling to different products, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, Suzano, PepsiCo, and others. Every member of our team directly affects the results of our clients. As part of this team, you will be in contact with clients to understand their needs and help create solutions to improve their maintenance processes.

What you'll do

As an Implementation Engineer at TRACTIAN, you will be responsible for deploying and maintaining cutting-edge Condition-based Monitoring (CbM) solutions for our industrial clients. You will work directly with Reliability teams, ensuring that best practices in asset management and predictive maintenance are effectively implemented.

You will lead the project implementation from initiation to Go-Live, ensuring seamless system integration into manufacturing and industrial environments. Additionally, you will conduct alignment meetings with clients, define deadlines and deliverables, and ensure the quality of project implementation.

Your role will provide clients with reliable tools to optimize machine performance and predictive maintenance. Your expertise will drive our mission to enhance machine reliability and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management: Manage all project stages, ensuring that deadlines and deliverables are met within the stipulated timeframe.
  2. Client Alignment Meetings: Conduct alignment meetings with clients, define deadlines and deliverables, and ensure the quality of project implementation.
  3. Technical Asset List Review: Review the technical asset list, ensuring that all necessary information is available for a safe and effective project implementation.
  4. Process Mapping: Conduct a full process mapping of the client's operations, identifying key performance indicators, key users, and internal champions to drive project adoption.
  5. Master Field Installation Plan: Develop the Master Field Installation Plan, a technical reference document that will guide the installation process, prioritize sensor placement, and include the necessary regulatory standards to ensure proper sensor installation.
  6. Structured Handoff: Ensure a well-structured handoff process, guaranteeing the complete transfer of information to internal teams and securing the project's long-term success.
  7. Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance system implementations and provide feedback on product development, ensuring solutions effectively meet industrial client needs.

Requirements

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Production, Mechatronics, Automation).
  2. Strong knowledge of Maintenance and Reliability Project Management.
  3. Solid troubleshooting skills with expertise in real-time monitoring.
  4. Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to continuous improvement.
  5. Excellent communication skills for client training and documentation purposes.
  6. Knowledge of maintenance performance indicators (MTTR, MTBF, MTTA, among others).
  7. Proficiency in Project Management Software and Project Management Methodologies (MS Project).
  8. Knowledge of CRM systems (HubSpot).

Bonus Points

  1. Advanced/Fluent proficiency in English and Spanish.

Compensation

  1. Competitive salary and stock options.
  2. Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses.
  3. 30 days of paid annual leave.
  4. Education and courses stipend.
  5. Employee Giving.
  6. Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years.
  7. Day off during the week of your birthday.
  8. Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance.
  9. Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation.
  10. Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  11. Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities.

title: Manager, Commercial Planning
description:
Why PlayStation?

PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Today, we’re recognized as a global leader in entertainment producing The PlayStation family of products and services including PlayStation5, PlayStation4, PlayStationVR, PlayStationPlus, acclaimed PlayStation software titles from PlayStation Studios, and more.

PlayStation also strives to create an inclusive environment that empowers employees and embraces diversity. We welcome and encourage everyone who has a passion and curiosity for innovation, technology, and play to explore our open positions and join our growing global team.

The PlayStation brand falls under Sony Interactive Entertainment, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation.

Manager, Commercial Planning

S ao Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

The Manager, Commercial Planning will support demand forecasting across all PlayStation Categories (Hardware, Software and Peripherals) for the Latin America Region. In this role, you will collaborate with cross functional teams across Global, Americas, and local Latin American markets to contribute to a robust, consensus based demand plan. This position plays an important role in aligning demand with supply, improving forecast accuracy, supporting new product introductions, and driving S&OP processes to ensure operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

You will have an opportunity to apply your business acumen, analytical mindset and organizational skills to help scale a growing regional business.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, PlayStation LATAM, this role supports key planning activities and offers visibility into strategic decision-making.

What You’ll Do:

  1. Lead and coach a regional commercial planning team, fostering collaboration, development, and performance excellence.
  2. Contribute to the development and execution of short- and long-term demand forecasts at product, category, and channel levels, using historical data, market trends, and promotional inputs.
  3. Support the S&OP process by working closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to ensure alignment and accuracy.
  4. Act as a key liaison between regional sales teams, marketing, and operations to maintain coordinated and well-informed demand plans.
  5. Assist in building the yearly budget, quarterly forecast and monthly flash sales plans and follow its performance, reporting and explain variances.
  6. Support executive-level reporting and presentations with accurate and insightful forecasting data.
  7. Engage with channel teams to collaborate on forecasting and obtain and ensure that current and accurate information is used for demand forecasts.
  8. Monitor assumptions, risks, and opportunities impacting the demand plan, and communicate implications as needed.
  9. Review historical sales trends, research demand drivers, prepare forecast data, develop statistical forecast models, and evaluate results.
  10. Coordinate with Global and Americas planning teams to communicate market requirements and updates.
  11. Support Sales, MKT and Head of Sales on ad-hoc analysis to run the business. Manage day to day sales and planning operation.
  12. Improve data quality by ongoing validation & follow up of sell-out and sell-through.
  13. Understand new product introduction roadmaps to manage product transitions.

What We’re Looking For:

  1. 8+ years of relevant experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Operations or Sales Planning.
  2. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Engineering or related field.
  3. Past experience directly managing and developing a team while delivering strong business outcomes.
  4. Solid understanding of forecasting processes, S&OP, and commercial planning.
  5. Familiarity with planning tools such as SAP/IBP.
  6. Highly analytical, data-driven decision maker with strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  7. Ability to interpret complex data sets (both qualitative and quantitative) and present findings clearly and effectively.
  8. Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills and a solution-oriented mindset.
  9. Enthusiastic and confident team player with excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to connect and collaborate effectively across diverse teams. Brings an innovative mindset and learns quickly in dynamic environments.
  10. Clear and concise written skills. Ability to concept, write and develop persuasive, organized presentations.
  11. High level of organization and flexibility to deal with urgent requests.
  12. Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint.
  13. Bilingual in English is a must (Spanish is a plus).

Esse profissional será responsável por analisar dados de performance, mapear oportunidades de crescimento nos canais online, explorar tendências de mercado e conduzir o ciclo de vida dos produtos digitais — do garimpo à escala. Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar análises comerciais com base em dados de performance dos canais digitais (vendas, navegação, abandono de carrinho, conversão), traduzindo informações em decisões estratégicas para impulsionar resultados.
  • Monitorar métricas e indicadores de desempenho dos marketplaces, identificando padrões, tendências e pontos de melhoria para alavancar a performance.
  • Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e benchmarking de forma contínua para antecipar tendências, entender o posicionamento da concorrência e identificar demandas reais do público-alvo.

  • Acompanhar o desempenho de campanhas digitais (tráfego pago, SEO, e-mail marketing, redes sociais), sugerindo ajustes com base em dados e resultados.
  • Sugerir e implementar ações de performance como combos, kits, descontos e campanhas de recompra, com base em dashboards e relatórios dinâmicos.

With over 6,500 CI&Ters around the world, we’ve built partnerships with more than 1,000 clients during our 30 years of history. Artificial Intelligence is our reality.

**Please submit resume's in English to be considered**

About the team:

The Enterprise Architecture team operates globally as an ensemble cast that supports the business, product, and technology stakeholders throughout the merchant business. You will be part of a team of highly skilled Enterprise Architects that work to design the foundation for how our global payments platforms perform and scale. Your expertise will define how the variety of existing and emerging payment capabilities interoperate to create valuable propositions that build out next generation payments propositions. This is a team sport where the collective knowledge of the team and organization are harnessed to create thoughtful end-to-end solutions in collaboration with senior leaders and stakeholders from across the company.

About the role:

We are seeking a seasoned and visionary leader with experience within the payments industry to fill the role of Enterprise Architect. This critical position will drive the direction, development, and implementation of our Technology Strategy to ensure alignment with our business objectives and technological advancements. The ability to execute across a matrixed organization with colleagues located globally will be required.

What you will be doing:

Strategic Planning: Develop and execute the enterprise Technology Strategy in alignment with the organization’s long-term goals and objectives.

Leadership: Provide leadership within the enterprise architecture team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Technology Roadmap: Define and maintain the technology roadmap, identifying emerging trends, evaluating new technologies, and making recommendations for adoption or enhancement.

Transformation: Experience driving large-scale Transformation Programs, specifically with cloud transformations and application modernization.

Governance: Establish and enforce architectural standards, policies, and procedures to ensure consistency, reliability, and security across all IT systems and platforms.

Collaboration: Collaborate with business leaders, IT teams, and other stakeholders to understand business needs, translate them into technical requirements, and develop scalable solutions.

Roadmap and Strategy: Experience taking ownership, communicating and delivering technology roadmaps and strategies that align with the objectives of the business.

Current and Future State: Understand the landscape of the client and create current and future state diagrams while collaborating with the organization as required.

Architecture Repository: Enhance and maintain the architecture repository to enable artifacts to be accessible throughout the company.

title: Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector
description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Software Platform Engineering Manager - Ubuntu for Next-Gen Silicon role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring engineering managers who are passionate about operational systems, open source technologies and cutting-edge hardware to lead engineering teams to enable and optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x and POWER systems.
We partner with the world's leading silicon vendors to optimise Ubuntu on their latest platforms. We integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements in Ubuntu while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.
Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You will be expected to drive healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisations as well as lead your team to deliver high-quality design and code.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role. We have open positions in every time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes

  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Sobre a Vaga:

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Médicos Geriatras apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Diagnóstico que Buscamos:

  • Formação em Medicina com Residência em Geriatria, Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para o estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós:

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar atendimento de qualidade, acessível e humanizado através da telemedicina, promovendo o bem-estar mental e emocional dos pacientes. O médico geriatra deve atuar com empatia, responsabilidade e ética, garantindo diagnósticos e tratamentos assertivos, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e contribuindo para a melhoria de sua qualidade de vida. Fortalecer a confiança no atendimento remoto, assegurando que cada consulta seja conduzida com o mesmo rigor e acolhimento de um atendimento presencial.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.
  • Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidar, mantendo-os atualizados.
  • Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.
  • Realizar o Cuidado Integral ao Paciente, cuidando com Empatia e Carinho, estabelecendo vínulos e considerando as suas necessidades biopsicossociais.
  • Garantir a continuidade da Assistência Médica por meio da execução do Plano de Cuidado estabelecido.
  • Distribuir adequadamente a agenda de consultas, cumprindo a carga horária e número de atendimentos, conforme o contrato estabelecido.

title: Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector
description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Graduate Legal Counsel - Tech Sector role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the MÉDICO NEUROLOGISTA - CER role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde .

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar atividades na especialidade de neurologia, diagnosticar e prevenir patologias, indicar tratamentos e procedimentos relacionados ao cérebro, medula espinhal, nervos periféricos e músculos, visando acompanhamento e/ou reabilitação do paciente, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria de Saúde.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Willis Towers Watson (WTW) is seeking ambitious, analytical underwriting talent with 5-10 years of experience in the insurance industry with experience in builders’ risk and property underwriting. Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.

The Role

  • Work with WTW’s broking team(s), Verita executives, actuaries, and cat modelers to analyze Verita’s insurance risks on a portfolio level to obtain capacity in the form of delegated authority, reinsurance structures and/or other innovative solutions.
  • Negotiate and place Reinsurance Treaties and/or FAC placements utilizing markets from London, the US, Bermuda and around the world.
  • Coordinate and attend underwriting and claim audits with Verita’s capacity markets on a regular basis.
  • Ensure that company, market and client related documentation is issued (internally and externally) accurately and on time.
  • Comply with external regulatory and internal statutory policies, procedures and regulations.
  • Coordinate internal resources, such as analytics, contracts and client services to provide solutions to client(s).
  • Meet with senior management both internally and externally to present materials.
  • The candidate must have experience in Builder’s Risk, General Liability and Property
    • Candidates with significant experience/relationships in one of these areas will be considered and expected to develop the expertise in the other areas.
  • Conduct comprehensive market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks to Verita’s portfolio.
  • Engage with capacity providers and reinsurance markets to negotiate terms, pricing, and coverage to secure optimal outcomes for Verita.
  • Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory changes, and emerging risks that may impact reinsurance strategies.
  • Assist in the training and development of graduate hires.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  • Good understanding of pricing components and rating methodologies
  • Uses all appropriate underwriting tools, disciplines and knowledge of strategies to ensure underwriting guidelines are followed
  • Exhibits strong underwriting skills through strategic, thorough account reviews and file documentation
  • Adheres to guidelines and underwriting discipline to minimize exposure and appropriately price risk.
  • Complete understanding and ability to use sophisticated pricing models across various structures, guaranteed cost, captives, SIR’s, deductibles, etc.

Qualifications

The Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from a four-year College or university.
  • 8+ years of work experience, preferably in Property and Casualty insurance, reinsurance or related non-life insurance consulting.
  • Understanding of Managing General Underwriter program life cycles and placements.
  • Strong negotiation skills
  • Ability to multi-task priorities in a fast-paced, high intensity environment.
  • Experience in giving presentations to prospects, capacity partners and internal groups.
  • Computer skills, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook.
  • Effective analysis, problem solving and communication skills.
  • Strong knowledge of property insurance policies and regulations.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in assessments.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Very strong technical and leadership qualities
  • Well established in the marketplace and has excellent relationships with brokers and agents on both regional and national level
  • Well versed and experienced in working, producing and underwriting all sizes of accounts with large brokerage houses, agents and specialty retailers.
  • Established underwriting, quoting and binding track record of profitable business.

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until a sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).

Compensation
The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $150,000 - $250,000 USD per year. This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.
Company Benefits
WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave),Paid Time Off

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

title: Director, Ecosystem Engineering
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

Join us in shaping the future of Fortnite — one of the world’s most influential interactive platforms. We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader to drive the development of foundational systems that support the Fortnite experience at scale — including player onboarding, progression, identity, lobbies, and purchasing. These systems form the connective tissue of the Fortnite ecosystem, powering player interaction, progression, and seamless transitions between experiences. This role is central to our goal of delivering consistent, high-quality user experiences across internal and third-party content — while enabling scale, flexibility, and innovation for the entire platform.

In this role, you will

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for Fortnite’s ecosystem systems, driving scalability, consistency, and platform evolution.
  • Lead development of features that span all Fortnite content, ensuring unified experiences and reliable scale across modes
  • Partner with internal teams (e.g., Battle Royale, LEGO Fortnite, new IPs) to ensure systems align with desired flows and player-facing requirements.
  • Collaborate with third-party developers to enable flexible, performant integration with Fortnite's shared systems.
  • Grow and lead a high-performing team, fostering a culture of innovation, inclusion, and engineering excellence.
  • Drive platform evolution while balancing stability, performance, and flexibility for diverse use cases.
  • Drive innovation and creative problem solving in areas that do not have an internal precedent

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience architecting and building user-facing systems in a live services or platform environment (e.g., menus, accounts, progression, commerce).
  • Strong understanding of scalable backend and client-service patterns, ideally in cross-platform or online service contexts.
  • Comfortable navigating complex user flows and dependencies across multiple teams and surfaces.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills with a track record of cross-functional collaboration.
  • Passion for building intuitive, reliable systems that support a wide range of player and developer needs.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

title: OFFSHORE - SUPERVISOR DE PROJETOS
description:
Ser responsável pelos processos de administração da hotelaria em atendimento e satisfação do efetivo embarcado da unidade de trabalho, de acordo com as normas e procedimentos adotados pela empresa e auditoria interna nas dependências do cliente (embarcações/plataformas).

Responsabilidades:

  1. Acompanhar todo movimento do estoque em todas as áreas da unidade de trabalho, verificando diariamente o mesmo, planejando os consumos dos produtos de acordo com suas respectivas datas de validade de modo que não haja descarte desnecessário, também sendo de sua responsabilidade o desempenho em relação aos limites de consumos estabelecidos pela empresa – traduzindo em custos.
  2. Receber e armazenar todas as mercadorias recebidas no rancho, seguindo os padrões PVPS, confirmando o recebimento das mercadorias enviadas nos ranchos periódicos, através da relação enviada pela Expedição / Supervisão. Qualquer alteração nos padrões de consumo deve ser enviada juntamente com o pedido e justificada.
  3. Controlar e checar os cardápios diariamente para que não haja alterações no cardápio padrão, acompanhar os mesmos pré-estabelecidos e suas fichas de preparação quando aplicável, para que sejam produzidos eficientemente e da forma requisitada pelo cliente, acompanhando as quantidades produzidas e repostas durante refeições e lanches.
  4. Realizar obrigatoriamente visitas à cozinha às 07:00h; 08:30h; 10:00h; 14:30h; 16:00h e às 19:00h, para supervisão da limpeza, arrumação e organização de equipamentos e utensílios, verificando se as pias estão vazias e limpas, se as panelas estão tampadas ou limpas e embocadas para baixo, se as placas de altileno estão imersas em solução sanitizante, se os objetos cortantes estão devidamente protegidos e guardados, se os equipamentos estão sendo utilizados corretamente ou se estão devidamente limpos e desligados e, se os colaboradores estão utilizando os EPI’s em concordância com as atividades exercidas.
  5. Coordenar as equipes para que as refeições e lanches sejam organizados nas rampas adequadamente e servidos no horário contratual, sempre verificando a limpeza do refeitório antes, durante e após o serviço, além de realizar as provas das refeições com antecedência antes de servi-las, alterando-as caso haja necessidade; e em concordância com o cliente.
  6. Acompanhar a separação das carnes para descongelamento, pré-preparo e preparo das mesmas.
  7. Acompanhar o cumprimento de normas da ANVISA: coleta de amostras; verificação e controle de temperaturas dos alimentos e equipamentos.
  8. Verificar constantemente, os pontos de lanches, solicitando reposição de mercadorias, caso necessário, obedecendo criteriosamente o instrumento contratual.
  9. Criar listas de tarefas para seus subordinados referentes às limpezas a serem efetuadas diariamente, semanalmente e mensalmente. Controlar e acompanhar os mesmos.
  10. Verificar diariamente a limpeza dos camarotes, escritórios, salas de lazer, e da lavanderia, como também acompanhar as realizações das higienizações cumprindo na íntegra o cronograma estabelecido na unidade. Além de observar o desempenho da equipe e a satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços prestados destas áreas.
  11. Realizar diariamente o DDSMS, orientando os funcionários em normas de higiene, SMS e procedimentos operacionais, auditoria comportamental e demais tópicos necessários, adicionando tópicos solicitados pelo cliente ou pela base.
  12. Desenvolver e treinar sua equipe, possibilitando o desenvolvimento e crescimento interno dos mesmos, mantendo a disciplina e harmonia dentro de sua equipe, visando o bom desenvolvimento, com foco na qualidade, dos serviços prestados na unidade de trabalho.
  13. Manter sempre sua equipe informada com datas de embarque, férias, incluindo a passagem de informações gerais para equipes embarcando, tais como: comunicações de embarque e quaisquer demais informes provenientes da base.
  14. Realizar a avaliação de desempenho dos profissionais de sua equipe embarcados, de acordo com os critérios adotados pela empresa.
  15. Enviar, periodicamente, os RDH’s / FATURAS por e-mail, ou quando solicitadas, estas deverão ser assinadas e enviadas digitalizadas.
  16. Realizar inventário de todos os produtos enviados pela empresa.
  17. Realizar controle de saída diária dos alimentos.
  18. Controlar desperdício, levando em consideração a quantidade planejada, sobra limpa, sobra suja e resto ingestão.
  19. Reportar a base qualquer solicitação ou ocorrência de imediato.
  20. Realizar controle de validade.
  21. Realizar implantação e auditorias dos processos offshore.

Senior Professional Services Consultant

The Technical Solutions Consultant should demonstrate acumen in the relevant LexisNexis products (including software and hardware as applicable), knowledge of common industry practices, and possesses proficiency with tools processes, and methods required to execute duties as described above.

This is a hybrid position, applicants must be able to work from our Sao Paulo office 1-3 times per week. Currently, we are meeting in the office once a week. This is subject to change, though there are no current plans to increase our office frequency.

Accountabilities:

  • Provides technical integration and consulting services directly to external clients, sales teams, and other support staff for financial services, collections, healthcare, government, law enforcement, and insurance verticals for business services' products.
  • Shares product knowledge, best practices, and technical examples with clients in order to advance implementation completion.
  • Conducts analysis and applies problem-solving skills to determine root cause of issues. Collaborates with and escalates to appropriate resources when necessary to get issues addressed.
  • Owns correspondence with Sales and client until issue is resolved.
  • Provides installation, implementation, and configuration support, while keeping implementation project plans up-to-date.
  • Communicates technical terms to internal and external clients of varying levels of technical understanding.
  • Utilizes technical expertise in providing 3rd-level XML support to clients.
  • Conducts technical presentations and product demonstrations regarding integration with LexisNexis Risk Solutions' products.
  • Participates in departmental projects that improve the productivity of the team.
  • Completes required training and skill development to support the client base, individual developmental needs, team objectives, department goals, and company initiatives.
  • Maintains a detailed understanding of databases programming, search technologies, and web technologies.
  • Develops a consultative sales style which incorporates technical skills while delivering business value.
  • Stays focused on revenue and remains willing to take the initiative to ensure that LexisNexis wins the decision.
  • Continues building on best practices for improved client satisfaction, while looking for opportunities and submitting ideas to improve team effectiveness and productivity in working with Sales, clients, and Web Service solutions.
  • Provides trends and ideas to management and product owners to consider in future products.
  • Represents the XML Consultants team in targeted meetings.
  • Serves as a mentor for the technical solution consultants.

Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience in a related field.
  • Must be able to travel up to 25% of the time.
  • Consultative skills with the ability to collaborate and explore options, to demonstrate and effectively use active listening skills to understand client needs.
  • Ability to use data quality concepts and tools to effectively resolve client issues, while valuing client needs as a high priority.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • Basic Spanish, preferably Intermediate level.

Technical skills:

  • Working knowledge and/or specialized understanding of Software Development Life Cycle.
  • Windows Operating Systems.
  • SOAP/JSON web services and XML.
  • Producing technical documentation.
  • Notion of Cloud infrastructure (Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, OpenShift, Google Cloud).

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional recent graduate as junior Legal Advisor or junior Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical they will have the opportunity to work on a variety of transactional matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as the contracts that underpin global employment, contracting and partnerships. In this appointment we are more focused on ability than experience; the position is open to applicants with a relevant degree, but does not have a requirement for extensive work experience. The successful candidate will work closely with our in-house legal team and colleagues worldwide.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate good commercial judgment as well as being organized, efficient, and capable to provide high quality legal and commercial advice. We are looking for a rigorous work ethic, detailed analysis, conscientiousness, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement.
Location : This role is home based in Europe, the Middle East, Africa or the Americas, with the option of our London office.
The role entails

  • Report to our global general counsel
  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts with customers and vendors in many countries across the globe
  • Provide legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical's sales organization
  • Interface with cross-functional teams to support company initiatives
  • Utilize Canonical's contract management system to ensure accurate data is maintained for signed contracts
  • Work with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active license to practice law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-cultural environment
  • Effective both independently and as part of a team
  • A passion for technology evidenced by personal initiatives and projects
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Appreciative of diversity; polite and effective in a multicultural multinational organization
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience in commercial transactions, intellectual property, or corporate law
  • Leadership and the ability to influence others to embrace new ideas or practices
  • Understanding of the open source software community and values
  • Understanding of the technology industry - silicon, data centers, PCs, connected devices, and software
  • Experience working on in-house legal team and/or law firm
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Regional Product Director, Threat Intelligence Solutions – LAC (RF #177)-R-242678
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart, and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses, and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Regional Product Director, Threat Intelligence Solutions – LAC (RF #177)

About us
At Mastercard, we are committed to safeguarding the digital ecosystem by pioneering cutting-edge security solutions. As cyber threats evolve, so do we—leveraging deep expertise in network security and data intelligence to protect transactions worldwide. We don’t just react to cyber threats; we stay ahead of them.

As a key member of the Security Solutions Organization (SSO), you’ll be at the forefront of this mission, ensuring our Threat Intelligence solutions empower businesses across Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) to mitigate risks and build resilience in an increasingly complex cybersecurity landscape.

Your role

As Regional Product Director, Threat Intelligence Solutions, you will be the primary advocate for our intelligence-driven security products across LAC. You’ll lead go-to-market strategies, revenue growth, and product adoption while collaborating with internal teams and external stakeholders to drive innovation. Your expertise will shape how financial institutions and businesses across the region combat cyber threats.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead Regional Strategy & Execution—Manage the Threat Intelligence solutions market performance across LAC, overseeing revenue performance, defining KPIs, growth plans, and expansion strategies to develop a sustainable business model.
  2. Drive Revenue and Product Adoption—Oversee sales performance, support and maintain a strong customer pipeline, identify new opportunities, and develop business cases to scale our offerings.
  3. Product Roadmap & Market Insights—Collaborate with global teams to refine and localize solutions based on customer feedback and regional and local needs.
  4. Customer Engagement & Advocacy—Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring seamless onboarding, training, and continuous value delivery.
  5. Cyber Threat Intelligence Thought Leadership—Stay ahead of emerging threats and market trends, shaping how Mastercard delivers security across the payment and financial sectors.

What We’re Looking For

  1. Threat Intelligence Expertise—Deep understanding of cyber risk management, information security, and threat intelligence solutions.
  2. Payments & Financial Sector Experience—Strong industry knowledge and experience with financial institutions, payment networks, or fintechs.
  3. Proven Product Leadership—Background in product management, go-to-market strategy, and customer-driven innovation.
  4. Strategic & Analytical Mindset—Strong business case development, financial acumen, and ability to translate data into insights.
  5. Strong Communicator & Collaborator—Ability to work cross-functionally, influence stakeholders, and drive impact in a fast-moving environment.
  6. Multilingual Proficiency—Fluency in English (Spanish is highly recommended).

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks come with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

  • Leverage expertise in alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB to contribute to cross-functional database projects.
  • Manage and optimize cloud-based database environments , ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability in cloud infrastructure.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Solidhands-on experience in MS SQL Server Database Administration in production environments.
  • Extensive experience with MS SQL Server database features, including Jobs Scheduling, Monitoring, Patching, Backup/Recovery, Replication, Availability Groups , and Always On configurations.
  • Proven expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance bottlenecks and availability issues .
  • Solid understanding of alternative database engines like PostgreSQL , MongoDB and CockroachDB , with practical experience in their administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in cloud database administration , with experience in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Fluency in English , both written and verbal, with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, alongside a proactive approach to continuous learning.
